name: Margin of Insight — Research API
description: Pre-computed Wall Street-grade equity research as structured JSON for AI agents and LLMs. Free primer (no auth), $1.00 fundamental analysis, $2.00 full investment memo. Paid endpoints accept a Stripe Link Shared Payment Token (SPT) — no marginofinsight account, no static credential, no pre-funded balance. US-listed SEC filers only.
